detailed_description: JSON Escape/Unescape is a small browser-side text helper. Paste text into the input textarea and click Escape to run JSON.stringify on the whole input string, producing a quoted JSON string with escaped control characters, quotes, and backslashes where needed. Click Unescape to run JSON.parse on the input; if the parsed value is a string it is shown directly, otherwise it is formatted with JSON.stringify(value, null, 2). The output textarea is read-only and can be copied. The tool does not provide AST analysis, line numbers, syntax highlighting, preserve-whitespace options, strict mode toggles, custom indentation controls, injection protection, or file import/export.
usage_steps: Paste text or a quoted JSON string into the input textarea
Click Escape to wrap the input with JSON.stringify and escape special characters
Click Unescape to parse a JSON string or JSON value with JSON.parse
If processing fails, the output shows a generic error message
Click Copy to copy the generated output
usage_examples: Escape a multiline text snippet before pasting it as a JSON string value
Unescape a quoted JSON string to read the original line breaks and tabs
Parse a JSON value and format non-string output with two-space indentation
Copy the escaped output for a quick test payload
